# 151 Camps on the 9:00–10:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## 17 Virgins

**Where:** A & 9:15 · **From:** Toronto · **Landmark:** 17Virgins Owl and the 250 FUCKING FOOT LONG TUNNEL · **Year:** 2026

Invites you to the transdimensional portal. Come explore our 250' long tunnel to another universe! Who knows you may find a hidden doorway to the party of your dreams.

*More: https://17virgins.bm/*

## AAA Astro Accessible Arcade

**Where:** 9:00 B Plaza @ 8:15 · **From:** Gilroy, CA · **Landmark:** the double peaked circus tent · **Year:** 2026

A Space Age-inspired camp featuring accessible arcade games, immersive experiences, and a community space designed for radical inclusion. Think retro-futurism meets playa magic where everyone can play, connect, and experience wonder.

*More: https://www.dawncollective.org*

## Accult

**Where:** 9:30 & A · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** a big LED 'neon' sign that says Accult · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock City's preeminent venue for ascending to the next plane of existence. Come to us in order to register for planar ascension and join us in our standardized ritual initiation or SRI. We look forward to collecting you.. er uhm we mean assisting you in the next stage of your planar journey.

*More: https://www.accult.camp*

## adult playground

**Where:** E & 9:45 · **From:** Long Island NY , · **Landmark:** slide · **Year:** 2026

Simple human connection. We offer daily sessions including Morning Flow, Midday Reset, and an evening social hour that creates an easy space for people to meet and unwind. Our main attraction is a tall oiled slide that invites participants to let go and play like kids again, with camp members on hand to keep everything safe and fun. On select afternoons we gift authentic fried pizza made fresh in camp. Throughout the day visitors can drop in for stretching, grounding, conversation, or a moment of shade. Adult Playground is a relaxed, friendly space designed to help people reset, connect, and enjoy the lighter side of the playa.

## Airpusher Collective

**Where:** E & 9:15 · **From:** Oakland CA · **Landmark:** Airpusher Archway · **Year:** 2026

The Airpusher camp is the port from which our fantastical airship begins and ends her voyages. Join us for music and joy. Check our event schedule and meet us at camp prior to our published airship rides to playa and beyond.

*More: https://airpusher.org/*

## Alborz

**Where:** E & 9:45 · **From:** Brooklyn · **Landmark:** Mountain Range of shade with large neon sign · **Year:** 2026

If you find yourself parched and disoriented, listen carefully. Follow the melody and you may just stumble across camp Alborz. We'll be happy to nurture your body and soul before we send you back off to find the next adventure.

*More: https://www.campalborz.org*

## Arctica Ice Sales - Ice Nine

**Where:** 9:00 G Plaza @ 4:30 · **From:** Iceland · **Landmark:** Igloo · **Year:** 2026

## Ashram Galactica

**Where:** 9:00 & J · **From:** Venice Beach , CA · **Landmark:** Large Morrocan Tent and Ashram Galactica sign · **Year:** 2026

The Grand Hotel | Your Home Away From Home Away From Home Located Directly Above the Center of the Earth

*More: https://ashramgalactica.com/*

## Aya The Tiger

**Where:** D & 9:15 · **Landmark:** large dome with tiger on it · **Year:** 2026

We are a healing-centered camp offering psychedelic peer support, yoga, meditation, and a sacred tobacco ceremony. Our team includes experienced volunteers, therapists, and physicians trained in harm reduction and emotional care. We provide a calm, welcoming sanctuary for anyone in need of grounding, connection, or support throughout the week.

## Backstage

**Where:** 9:30 & E · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** "Backstage" Sign · **Year:** 2026

Backstage is an interactive electronic music camp built as a rotating audience-to-artist-to-crew ritual. Part social music installation and part anti-spectator experience, it invites guests into a structured participation loop of backstage creation, onstage performance, and front of house support. Participants create a track in a guided music studio behind the stage, hear it come alive on stage, then help light the next act before returning to the dance floor. We also host live experimental electronic music, dance parties, and late night ambient sets.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/campbackstage*

## badlands

**Where:** 9:30 & F · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Badlands flags and mailbox in front · **Year:** 2026

Badlands is a live music open jam camp. Formed in 2011, we have always had a drum kit (or 3), amps, guitar, bass, keys, and a PA with microphones available for anyone that wants to come by and play. All levels of musicianship (within reason haha) are welcome!! We are open from 3-7 Mon-Fri and oftentimes have random night jams too! We have topless bartenders and bottomless drinks at our bar and a comfy shaded area with games and couches to relax, enjoy music and get out of the sun.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/badlands_camp?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==*

## Best Year Yet

**Where:** 9:00 Portal & A · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Rainbow camp banner "Camp Best Year Yet" · **Year:** 2026

Providing the best hot drip coffee on playa every morning. Come enjoy a cup of Joe, a game of cribbage (or learn cribbage) and pay a visit to our magical gaseous eggplant!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61582790195548*

## Better Together

**Where:** E & 9:15 · **From:** Zurich, Tel-Aviv, San Diego, New York · **Landmark:** Better Together neon light sign · **Year:** 2026

Better Together Camp is where sparks fly and connections are made, literally, we're not responsible for any Playa-induced lightning strikes. Our Speed Dating isn't your average meet-and-greet; it's all about real conversations, radical self-expression, and a little bit of magic. Whether you're a Burning Man newbie or a dusty veteran, we've got a spot for you to connect, laugh, and maybe even find your Playa soulmate (or just a good chat). In our camp, everyone's welcome, and everyone's encouraged to be their weird, wonderful selves. Come for the speed dating, stay for the unforgettable memories, and remember: we're better together.

*More: https://bettertogether.camp/*

## Big Unicorn Energy

**Where:** 9:30 & K · **From:** Miami Beach · **Landmark:** Large unicorn head beacon, which lights at night · **Year:** 2026

## Bike Gods

**Where:** 9:00 & D · **From:** Reno, Sacramento, Paris, Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Red & White Shade Structure with LED Bike on top · **Year:** 2026

Bike trouble got ya down? Come visit the Bike Gods, where we practice self reliant bike repair 24 hours a day. Our camp features 8 fully equipped workstations and spare parts. We have caring and compassionate bike mechanics to assist you M-F 10am-12pm. Out on the Playa, look for our Bike Gods Taxi Service running yellow tandems.

*More: http://thebikegods.com*

## Black Rock City Shipyard

**Where:** D & 9:45 · **From:** Miami · **Landmark:** white tent with disco balls · **Year:** 2026

Where good vibes meet great times! Sip cocktails, savor glitzy hot dogs, and sway to groovy beats in a chilled lounge atmosphere. Cruise in, kick back, and let the party float you away

## Black Rock Piano Lounge

**Where:** 9:00 B Plaza @ 5:00 · **From:** Seattle WA · **Landmark:** All white tent structure with pianos and a sign · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Piano Lounge is the place to come and share your talent with a friendly audience. We bring great musicians to the playa but build our lounge for that spontaneous moments where the perfect vocals are combined with the best tuned pianos on the playa. Lets make some beautiful music together.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/meltonjohnartcar/*

## Bloom Camp

**Where:** Esplanade & 9:45 · **From:** New York · **Landmark:** Brown and beige geometric pyramid and orange shade · **Year:** 2026

Join us at Bloom Camp, where we help burners thrive - not just survive. Bloom is a portal to human flourishing, centered around our climbable art installation, Bloom Pyramid by Gregg Fleishman. From there, we open space for transformative conversations and workshops exploring art, culture, consciousness, and human potential. By day, come by for our signature mimosas and fresh smoothies. By night, we come alive with DJ sets, live music and link ups with Art cars. Come Bloom with us!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/bloom_camp_*

## Blue CATerpillar

**Where:** 9:30 & C · **From:** Huntingdon · **Landmark:** Blue Caterpillar Sign · **Year:** 2026

Come to the Wonderland Hookah Lounge to enjoy Tribal/Shamanic beats, herbal teas, cool smoothies and a variety of games like Backgammon, Chess, Checkers, Dice Poker, Spy, The Hat, Catan, CodeNames, UNO, etc. For those looking for more active entertainment we have a foosball, and the fire pit at night, so put your best foot forward!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/blue.caterpillar.camp*

## Book Club

**Where:** 9:30 & A · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** A series of roughwood a-frame structures · **Year:** 2026

Book Club is proud to open its doors to serve the citizens of Black Rock City. Join us in the evening for shenanigans, whimsy, and the slowest service you'll find on any side of the playa. Bring a book, read one of ours and get comfy for a while

## BRC Ski Resort

**Where:** 9:00 Portal · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** 40 foot tall SKI RAMP and the GONDOLA · **Year:** 2026

With great powder comes great responsibility. Black Rock City Ski Resort's EXTRAterrestrial hosts welcome all earthlings to join us for in the apres-ski experience of a lifetime. Send it on the dance floor with Frosty the Snowman Discoball and our iconic DJs, kick it and recharge with a SNOW CONE.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/brcskiresort*

## BRC Snow Club

**Where:** Esplanade & 9:00 Portal · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** giant scaffolding structure of the ski slope · **Year:** 2026

Welcome shredders! BRCSC is the home of the first (and only) ski slope on the Playa! Come get outfitted for boots and skis or a board in our Rental Shop, then ascend the slope to rip down our 60-foot long, multi-tiered dry ski hill! Don't ski or snowboard? No problem! We'll have saucers aplenty for shredders of all ages to come and fly down the slope! Also hosting nightly Après Ski parties with phenomenal DJs, performers, and more!

*More: http://www.brcsnow.club*

## Bumblepuss

**Where:** 9:00 & F · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** steam bath yurt and lavender dome · **Year:** 2026

Bumblepuss brings a spa theme to the playa with the addition of the aromatherapy focused Lavender Lounge. Visit and soak in the aromas while you relax in the shade after your Steam Bath from our sister camp.

## Bumpbed

**Where:** 9:45 & H · **From:** The Delta · **Landmark:** 4 pillar art car w/thousands LEDs &shade structure · **Year:** 2026

Bumping those beats across the playa far and wide

*More: https://www.instagram.com/bumpbed?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==*

## Bunny Meth Lab

**Where:** Esplanade & 9:30 · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** LED forest, 50 foot stretch tent, two white semis. · **Year:** 2026

Transcend your humanity and project your bunny personality. Bunny-human hybrids are the future. Come enjoy our Esplanade lounge and relax in large fur daybeds, listening to curated beats and sipping on craft cocktails. Daily sundown events with spontaneous happenstance all week long. Vibrant colors, mystical LED forests, and plenty of places to relax. Find the hidden interactive origin story experience.

## Camp Balagan

**Where:** 9:30 & E · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** Black Moroccan tent, red carpet & lit white flag · **Year:** 2026

Exists to create a playful, soulful, and immersive Moroccan desert experience rooted in music, connection, and creativity. "Balagan" is a joyful chaos we embrace that spirit with curated sonic journeys, shared rituals, and a warm, open atmosphere for self-expression and cultural fusion.

## Camp Canadianderthal

**Where:** D & 9:15 · **From:** Winnipeg · **Landmark:** Whack-Ca-Nuck w/Canadian Flag, Cariboutique, piano · **Year:** 2026

TRAGICALLY HIP LIVE Wednesday at 1:00pm! Find an outfit in our Cariboutique, offering a curated selection of vintage threads and pre-loved playa wear, refreshed daily. Smack down your northern neighbors in our life-size Whack-Ca-Nuck game. Play some tunes or sing along in our shaded piano lounge. Spreading Canadian love, missing our Phish Phans!

## Camp Elektra

**Where:** J & 9:15 · **From:** Munich · **Landmark:** Elektra sign. White 3-peak tent w/ red flags · **Year:** 2026

Come visit us and take a ride on our beautiful Dragon Elektra or hang out at the Dragon's Lair Lounge while sipping on a cold beverage and dancing to the beats of our camp DJs!

## Camp XUZA

**Where:** 9:15 & J · **From:** LAS VEGAS · **Landmark:** XUZA Art Car Sign at the end of XUZA's Driveway. · **Year:** 2026

Home of XUZA Art Car Every Night XUZA will be out on the prowl, seeking out Art installations to host parties and more.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/xuzaartcar/*

## Campoline

**Where:** 9:00 & E · **From:** Napa Valley, CA · **Landmark:** colorful parachutes / trampolines out front · **Year:** 2026

We are an artsy international dive bar of friendly folks and stiff drinks under the circus bigtop of cascading parachutes. You can jump on trampolines under the stars or sun, paint, stroll through art work, belly up to the bar, listen to canned music from show tunes to punk, watch live original music and varied performances, or climb the intellectual ladder of conversation. Just depends on the night, and the people participating, but always a dependably great time.

## Chair Camp

**Where:** E & 9:45 · **From:** White Salmon · **Landmark:** Big Mad Maxy Chair and Automan · **Year:** 2026

The Dusty, cozy-as-can-be living room with room for all of our Chair, automan, and TV people. Chair Camp is proud to be on playa for the fourth year, with 6 mutant vehicles and a 24/7 lounge-pad for when we're done stomping around deep playa + giving lifts to our burner neighbors and off adventuring. Cold beverages and warm, cozy hangs— Purrr.

*More: http://www.unrally.org*

## Cheat Codes

**Where:** A & 9:15 · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** analog sign that says, "Cheat Codes", lit at night · **Year:** 2026

Cheat Codes is a bespoke analog arcade offering games of wit and dexterity 24/7. Come play with us!

## Choo Choo

**Where:** 9:45 & F · **From:** Cyprus · **Landmark:** Pink neon-illuminated flags · **Year:** 2026

We have two art cars, bipolar express trains, we drive around the playa and play music, this year we will still build art.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/bipolarexpress.artcar?igsh=MWhrZnJsb3c2OHEy*

## Colita de Rana

**Where:** F & 9:15 · **From:** Alameda · **Landmark:** White and black Jolly Roger flag with a frog skull · **Year:** 2026

We are the friends and creators of the mesmerizing frog who glides around the playa in his dapper top hat. Become hypnotized by his glowing aura and find yourself transported to a new destination.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/la.rana.hypnotica/*

## Combat Zone

**Where:** 9:30 & A · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Flashing 'Hot Noods' Sign · **Year:** 2026

We serve the best late night food on the playa. Come see us at 4 am for dan dan noodles and chill beats all week.

## ConTent

**Where:** 9:30 & E · **Landmark:** LED Volleyball Court · **Year:** 2026

Jiggle your bones at the "Dome of the Dead", or enjoy the "Volleyball Court for the Deceased"!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/CampContent*

## Cozy Dinosaur

**Where:** C & 9:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large Bell Tent w/ Dinosaur Sign · **Year:** 2026

a safe and cozy place to party, relax and meet new friends! During the day, come escape the elements in our cozy shade structure where we'll be serving ice cold flavored seltzers. Kick back on our comfy seats, take a moment to reflect, or join one of our talks. Come by in the evening to listen to music and dance at our nightly party.

## D.F.C.B.(Don't Fckn' Care Bear)

**Where:** H & 9:45 · **From:** Kalispell · **Landmark:** DFCB Flag at the RV or DFCB camp signage @ front · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to "(Don't)_Care_A_Lot" the official home for the Don't Fckn' Care Bear art car. Please be quiet around here because the little bears are sleeping...

## Dacha

**Where:** 9:30 & D · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** Two big Merry-go-rounds with tent shade structure · **Year:** 2026

Experience a fateful encounters with strangers via our "Spin of Fate" game. Dance your ass off with our DJs spinning at the night with bar and hookahs provided!

*More: http://www.dachacamp.com*

## Deco Fish

**Where:** 9:45 & K · **From:** Placerville · **Landmark:** Illuminated Deco Fish Art Car Sign · **Year:** 2026

The DECO FISH ART CARS ARE exotic creatures of the deep. Bright rainbows of glorious PSYCHEDELIC illumination, with powerful FIRE effects and rockin' sound systems laced up with intricate ART DECO styling throughout. Come and say HI! And we'll give you a ride you won't forget.

*More: https://www.deco.fish/*

## Deep Playa Simulator

**Where:** D & 9:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Car port and trash fence that is out in deep playa · **Year:** 2026

Over are the days of having to haul your ass all the way out to the trash fence to enjoy the deep open playa! Now for the first time ever experience the joys and wonders of deep playa from the comfort of the city!

*More: https://deepplayasimulator.com/*

## Disco Mushroom

**Where:** A & 9:15 · **From:** Tahoe City · **Landmark:** Empty flatbed trailer out front with Black nissan · **Year:** 2026

We are Disco Mushroom's humans. We love disco anything & everything! Come say hello! Love, Alpine Artists Collective

*More: https://www.instagram.com/alpine_artists_collective/*

## Disfunktion

**Where:** 9:00 & E · **From:** CHAMONIX MT BLANC · **Landmark:** 2-3 large tripods, flames ,lasers · **Year:** 2026

Come join in with our wobbly world of Weebles , Music, Fire and Mayhem Evenings eclectic music , slushy's, fiery chill out areasMain event Pyjama party with funkiest PJ giveaways and Sounds

## DK50 Trash Fence Camp

**Where:** J & 9:15 · **From:** Jersey · **Landmark:** BRIGHT orange 'stand' with trash fence decor · **Year:** 2026

Hi, we are an art support camp supporting the Trash Fence Souveneirs project - come find it on inner playa and share your art. We love you. And stop by camp to also create a moment of art immersion.

## Do Baskets Dream

**Where:** C & 9:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 50 ft white stretch tent (Kaleidoscope Cafe) · **Year:** 2026

We are the art support camp for the "Do Baskets Dream on Shore or Sea" art piece on playa!

*More: https://www.dobasketsdream.com/*

## Draft Punk

**Where:** 9:00 & E · **From:** SAN DIEGO · **Landmark:** Tall camp with trash fence on top! · **Year:** 2026

In the future, Daft Punk steals OUR name, "dRaft Punk". We're here to steal it back. And we brought a LOT of ice-cold beer with us. Grab a cold one on the go, or hang out with us for the day.

## DraKasha

**Where:** I & 9:45 · **Landmark:** Large dragon art car size of medium city bus · **Year:** 2026

## Duane's Whirld

**Where:** J & 9:15 · **From:** Burlington · **Landmark:** 26-foot box truck with Budget Fuck signage · **Year:** 2026

DuanesWhirld is enjoying our 20th consecutive year en Playa, with many of our campers trekking from Vermont. Our camp supports the mutant vehicle Fluffy -- accessible public transit masquerading as a cloud wafting across the playa. A wheelchair lift and Braille rails accommodate that many more Burners into the artcar experience. We enjoy mass-gifting our fellow Burners with Deep Playa Beer Delivery (quenching the late afternoon thirst in the heat) and 'Smores (late nights in deep playa to ease the chill with warm gooey treats.) Each of those gatherings generates micro-community among those Burners brought together. Look for Fluffy!!

*More: https://duaneswhirld.com*

## El Pulpo Magnifico

**Where:** 9:30 & J · **From:** Humboldt County · **Landmark:** El Pulpo Magnifico flag · **Year:** 2026

This is where the giant, flaming metal octopus lives.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/elpulpomecanico/*

## ELEMENTUM

**Where:** 9:30 & B · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** 60' brown stripe tent and two belle tents · **Year:** 2026

Earth. Air. Water. Fire. The place to nurture your nature. Experience the balance and amplification of the four elements through yoga, workshops, sound, and dance parties. We offer a non-alcoholic bar serving matcha & elemental elixirs daily. We provide flow, connection, and restoration for people of all identities and points of view. Home of the Space Cow People and the MIDNIGHT INFERNO PARTY on Thursday. Magic happens here.

*More: https://www.elementumcamp.com/*

## Endstation

**Where:** 9:15 & J · **From:** Zurich · **Landmark:** Large beige tent, wood poles and BRC container · **Year:** 2026

Camp Endstation is your last stop before nowhere. Grab a ticket from our dispenser, find a seat, and see what happens. Some days it's a conversation workshop with strangers, other days a tarot reading you didn't plan on. When night falls, the Disorient Express takes over with beats, incense, and tea. Or catch the Loco Motive for a sunrise party before the heat hits. Between events, the tent is open, the tea is hot, and there's always a seat.

*More: https://endstation.camp*

## Entheos Community Village

**Where:** Esplanade & 9:15 · **From:** San Francisco Bay Area · **Landmark:** giant trampoline arena with angled bounce walls. · **Year:** 2026

Members of the Entheos Community organize one of the most diverse theme camps placed at the annual Burning Man event in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. Friends and members of the Entheos Community come from over 43 countries to contribute their effort, skills, and resources to the creation of Entheos @ Burning Man. The camp creates extensive 24/7 interactivity for all ages as a gift to the citizens of Black Rock City, functions as a pilgrimage home for its members, and serves as a nexus to meaningfully connect people from around the world across national, religious, and ideological lines. As part of Entheos' commitment to radical inclusion, we hold a significant portion of our camp capacity open each year to welcome people who are new to Entheos. Come play on the giant Trampoline Arena.

*More: http://www.entheosrising.org*

## ESD Station 9:00

**Where:** 9:00 & C · **From:** Glacier · **Landmark:** We are right behind the ESD medical St. at 3 & C · **Year:** 2026

ESD station 9 supports the ESD Medical station at 9 & C, it also the playa home to many ESD medical volunteers.

## Favela Culture

**Where:** 9:45 & I · **From:** Sao Paulo · **Landmark:** A large red skull face of Mutant Vehicle · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Favela ArtCar & Camp, inspired by the spirit of resilience, community, and creativity found in Brazil's most vibrant slum neighborhoods. Here, we celebrate connection beyond social labels and our iconic skull-shaped Art Car is a moving symbol of that message: a reminder that beneath it all, we are all equal. Come dance with us, share stories, and experience a space where differences dissolve into unity, art, and radical inclusion. In the Favela, everyone belongs.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/favela_artcar*

## Foam Home presents FOAMADELIC

**Where:** 9:30 & E · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** All-sphyr ontop big tan tent & huge solar arrays · **Year:** 2026

Foam Home presents FOAMADELIC to Black Rock City!! The Foamy Homies will foam blast & rinse sparkly clean burners, and collectively activate an altar for humanity & all life! Complete with mandatory consent training, practicing true Inclusivity for everyone! - Groups of 60 at a time for a total of 2000 people a day. Wednesday through Saturday from 12-1pm for families with kids, and 1-4:20pm for all.

## Fokaround

**Where:** 9:15 & F · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Lit camp sign and large orange tent at frontage · **Year:** 2026

Camp Fokaround is a welcoming, high-vibe lounge camp offering a space for connection, conversation, and creative expression in Black Rock City. By day, we host relaxed gatherings and intentional interactions. By night, our illuminated art car transforms into a roaming light sculpture that invites participants to cruise, pause, and share meaningful moments on the playa. Rooted in participation, consent, and communal effort, we create an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome to rest, connect, and contribute to the magic of Burning Man.

## Fomo Playalounge

**Where:** 9:00 Portal & A · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** 20x 40 shade/giant green school bus/teeter totter · **Year:** 2026

Phasmantis brings snow cones, pop tarts, and dank beats to the playa. Stop by on a hot day and grab a drink and some saucy snow cones to cool off.

## From Mars With Love

**Where:** E & 9:15 · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** a big array of solar panels · **Year:** 2026

Home of the Serendipity Mars Rover

## G

**Where:** F & 9:45 · **From:** New York · **Landmark:** yellow and orange sheer curtains flowing in tunnel · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to our living room, g. Grab a croissant and dance for an hour or ten. We're grateful you're here.

## Garage Mahal

**Where:** 9:15 & G · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 20' bamboo poles with Balinese flags · **Year:** 2026

Garage Mahal

## Great Vibrations

**Where:** 9:00 G Plaza @ 9:30 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** The giant silver shade structure · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Great Vibrations. Our camp is a sanctuary of movement, relaxation, and high-frequency energy, dedicated to restoring and elevating Burners through the power of vibration. We offer 24/7 zero gravity massage chairs, daytime spa services (12pm-5pm), and a Tuesday morning sunrise dance party you will not want to miss!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/greatvibrationsbm*

## Hakuna Matata

**Where:** 9:45 & G · **From:** Miami · **Landmark:** 53' dry-van with neon "Hakuna Matata" text · **Year:** 2026

Building art objects and art cars to light up the Playa Nocturnal Kaleidoscope! Promoting mindful and safe cruising. SLOW DOWN!!! Leave No Trace

*More: https://hakuna-matata.camp/*

## Halloween Camp

**Where:** C & 9:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Bedazzled disco skull on the dancefloor ceiling · **Year:** 2026

Halloween Camp presents brings out the inner child in all of us BOO-urners, taking us back to the delights of that special day, where anybody can be anyone. Stop by our Diskull Lounge for a moment of respite, dance, and connection!

*More: https://instagram.com/halloweencampbm*

## Hammered and Sickled

**Where:** E & 9:15 · **From:** Walnut Creek · **Landmark:** 30+ Country flags above our lounge structure · **Year:** 2026

Hammered and Sickled is an international camp compromised of members from 30 plus countries of origins. We run a flavored Vodka bar as well as other libations and our mantra is "No one leaves our bar thirsty or walking in a straight line". We offer the weary desert travelers an oasis where they can take a break, relax and kick their shoes off. Our campers come from different corners of the world, backgrounds and offer a variety of insights and opinions to liven up any conversation. We have our in house DJ's spinning lounge and mashups through out the day.

## HAVANA NIGHTS

**Where:** B & 9:15 · **From:** Dallas, Texas · **Landmark:** Palm Trees & 20-ft Lime Green Tent · **Year:** 2026

Experience the essence of a vibrant Latin dance party infused with the relaxed vibe of Miami. Encircled by palm trees, our spacious, shaded dance floor beckons. Relax on our plush, elevated chill pads or sway in hammocks. Savor the night with bottomless, hand-muddled frozen mojitos as world-class DJs deliver an electrifying mix of Cuban and Latin rhythms. Immerse yourself in culture with daily dance lessons and indulge in complimentary cotton candy. Join us on Thursday, from 10 PM to 3 AM, for the iconic 10TH ANNUAL HAVANA NIGHTS, the pinnacle of our week-long dance celebration.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/HavanaNightsParty/*

## Helios Hideout

**Where:** F & 9:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Red/orange pheonix with "Helios" sign · **Year:** 2026

Helios is a symbol of rebirth after hard times. It is a celebration of humanity and an invitation for us all to stand together in the challenging times ahead.

## Here

**Where:** C & 9:15 · **From:** Amsterdam · **Landmark:** Red Here Sign and Red Flamingo Arrows · **Year:** 2026

## Twats Your Gender?

**Where:** C & 9:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Lit-up TYG & Sky Bar with mirrored tiles signs · **Year:** 2026

An LGBTQ led camp inviting participants to explore creativity, identity, and connection through playful interactive experiences. Visitors can screen print personal items with the address of something meaningful and unique to this year's theme. Guests can also create whimsical insect artwork by stamping marbled paint from their bum to create wings onto a small canvas and adding bug bodies and details to design a one of a kind creature. Art can be taken home or left to dry in our gallery and collected later. Our intentionally provocative camp name is meant to spark conversation. Through humor, creativity, and participation we hope to encourage curiosity, foster understanding, and celebrate the radical inclusion that makes our community so powerful.
